ops.sql: INSERT INTO tb_question_option (f_id, f_question_id, f_option_text, f_order, f_create_time) VALUES (@f_id, @f_question_id, @f_option_text, @f_order, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE f_option_text=@f_option_text, f_order=@f_order
SELECT * FROM tb_question_option WHERE f_question_id=@f_question_id ORDER BY f_order ASC
